title: TECT-owner physical-empty bounded test remains blocked
question: With the finite-regulator functional, reference, normalization, finite parts, regulator, volume, boundary condition and limit order held to the prior contract, can the TECT owner admit E and evaluate the F_total[G_*]-F_total[E] sign, full Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability?
method: Hash-pin the current R-427 revalidation, R-420 preregistration, R-418 E boundary, R-170 applicability firewall, R-169 owner boundary and EXP-000790 future same-parent contract.
Enumerate the same fifteen fixed fields and verify that no single owner supplies their values; keep the requested G_* minus E orientation unchanged.
Preregister E with explicit required representative, measure/algebra, normalization, boundary preparation and physical-criterion fields, while rejecting zero/P1 aliasing.

Stop before any energy, derivative or Hessian evaluation when the common finite parent and admitted E are absent; run an independent reversed-field control, hostile mutations and Lean R434 scope checks.
finding: The primary TECT-owner audit passes 13/13, the independent reversed-field control passes 13/13, hostile controls reject 7/7 mutations, the integrated verifier passes 19/19 and Lean R434 compiles. All fifteen fields remain locked but unsupplied in one common owner. E is preregistered and explicitly not admitted. The sign F_total[G_*]-F_total[E], full Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability are all BLOCKED_NOT_EVALUATED; no numerical quantity is formed.
decision_reason: The owner boundary has not changed since R-427: a covariance candidate G_* and separate references do not provide one hash-pinned finite F_total domain containing a normalized physical-empty E. The bounded test must therefore stop at input admissibility. This is a blocked result, not a sign, stationarity, stability or nonexistence theorem.
decision_scope: Fresh TECT-owner input audit with the fifteen-field R-427/R-420 contract and F_total[G_*]-F_total[E] orientation fixed; E slot preregistered but not admitted; no energy, derivative, Hessian or limit evaluation.
boundary: R-434 does not evaluate the three physical quantities and does not identify E with zero or P1. It does not imply a physical vacuum, Yang-Mills dynamics, a mass gap, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
next_action: Supply one owner-approved hash-pinned finite parent containing both G_* and an admitted normalized E, then freeze common finite parts, regulator, volume, boundary, limit order, tangent, symmetry projector and error budgets before rerunning the unchanged tests.

adversarial_review.check: E remains an uninstantiated slot and zero/P1 replacement is rejected.
The fifteen fields remain unsupplied in one common finite parent, so G_* and E cannot be compared.
No unspecified counterterm or shift is allowed to manufacture E or an absolute comparison.
A covariance-owner condition is not promoted to full Reading-H stationarity without a full tangent and residual budget.
No projected Hessian is formed without a common orbit tangent, projector and error budget.
Input inadmissibility is not converted into a sign or nonexistence theorem.
The result remains T0, claim-nonbearing and outside Yang-Mills or mass-gap claims.

no_overclaim: R-434 records a blocked owner-input audit only. It does not evaluate a sign, stationarity or stability and makes no Yang-Mills or mass-gap claim.
